The Harmonious Salutations Bear is a bear mount that was available for free from the Battle.net Shop in China. It was provided as one of the free mounts (the other being the Ash'adar, Harbinger of Dawn) for returning players after NetEase and Blizzard Entertainment came to a licensing agreement on bringing World of Warcraft and other Blizzard games back to China. It is largely the same mount as the Big Blizzard Bear, with the only difference being a blue flag (Alliance) and a red flag (Horde) rather than the BlizzCon flag. See Harmonious Greetings Bear for the Classic-equivalent mount.
Harvest Golem V000-A is a harvest golem summoned by Sebastian Jurgens during the quest Rift Away. Upon defeating it, a Mech Arm will drop on the ground to complete the quest.
Harvest Wine is located in Stillstone Pond and Fungal Fields in Hallowfall.

The Harmonious Greetings Bear is a bear mount that was available for free from the Battle.net Shop in China. It was provided as one of the free mounts for returning players after NetEase and Blizzard Entertainment came to a licensing agreement on bringing World of Warcraft and other Blizzard games back to China. It is largely the same mount as the Big Blizzard Bear, with the only differences being the red harness, and a blue flag (Alliance) or a red flag (Horde) rather than the BlizzCon flag. See Harmonious Salutations Bear for the retail-equivalent mount.

The Hastily-Prepared Antidote is located next to Marin Noggenfogger on the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn. The antidote has been made with poison glands extracted from the slain Nerubian Saboteurs.
Hastily Constructed Blockades are located at the entrances to several buildings in Taelloch in the Ringing Deeps.
Harmonized Silk is the Catalyst currency during The War Within Season 1. It accumulates by one every two weeks up to a total of 8.

Harris is a hobgoblin located at the G.E.T.A. Headquarters in the Undermine. He is a member of G.E.T.A. and helped adventurers in hunting down a crocodile that was released by its owner after it got too big and started eating goblins. And also a skipper, called the Captain, who was organizing a band of skippers that had gotten into the Undermine sewers and were starting to populate, causing all sorts of problems.

He also sells replacement fibers for the cloak. Players are directed to him in Wrapped Up, part of the Phase Diving questline.

Haulbots are robots built by the Machine Speakers. They are used to haul and load cargo, for repairs, as training dummies, and as guards. In combat, they fight by winding up and letting out mighty punches, spinning up their servos and pursuing their target and by leaping at their enemy. They can also overclock themselves, increasing their attack and movement speed.

Headmaster Fynch is an Arathi located in Lightspark Commissary in Hallowfall. He is the headmaster of Lightspark Academy. Lightspark was founded under Headmaster Fynch. He handpicked several of the best officers to help him train the students, and each year he selects Arathi from a group of volunteers to study. During the war in Khaz Algar, his students included Edwyn Wyndsmithe, Edwyn Wyndsmithe, and Jenae Sacredpyke and was deciding on their ranks.
